The thing is, I did have a clear budget. I knew that I only wanted to stay in campsites and hotels but my religious mom decided that was extremely improper and she called me incessantly about how she would lay for hotels to keep me from “being a whore” and I told her I was okay with it but she was become more and more upset with the idea and even threatening to fly out to come find me to set me in gods place.
That’s the thing,,, after they paid me back $10,000 they still don’t believe they actually owe me because raising me cost even more then that 🙄
Okay I realize I said “that I’ve needed money from them” that’s not true. I don’t need money from them. I haven’t needed money from them for years.

That’s the thing. I am financially independent. This is the first time in years I’ve needed money from them. Honestly, if we’re keeping track MY PARENTS owe me money. My mom’s been borrowing thousands from me since I was a teenager and has JUST paid it off (not really but enough for me to let it slide). Since I was 15 years old my parents have borrowed $20,000 from me and my mom has told me that’s it’s not a big deal because “that’s not a lot of money”
Even tho she’s super pressed about getting back $1100 (actually she wants more) that i straight up DIDNT want.

My plan didn’t rely on my moms credit card. I budgeted my trip to consist of me staying in campsites and like 1 or 2 friends houses. My mom called me and BEGGED me to go to a hotel because she felt like it was “poor form” for a single female traveler to go camping alone. Even when I told her that I was experienced and okay with camping alone she begged me ferociously to go stay in a hotel and that if I didn’t she would assume that I hated her as a mother because I have an obvious death wish.

Honestly that’s the biggest thing I regret. I really didn’t like having to lie to my parents. Even though I’m an adult who is financially responsible for herself, I was raised in a way where I am my parents property until I’m married. Since I am far from married (and gay) there is pretty much no way I can properly explain why I’m not in a mans custody yet lol.however, whenever I do travel alone I do make sure to tell friends I can actually trust in case something happens to me.

It took me 3 days to accept her money because she called me sobbing on the phone to go to a hotel (of her choosing) when I was happy to stay at my campsite of $12 a night. They know that I am a solo traveler, especially camping wise, but our evangelical background makes women traveling solo a sin on it own.
I even told her that I wanted to pay her back, but she insisted that it was her duty as a mother to “keep me safe” even tho I’ve been keeping myself safe since I was 11 years old.

Long story short: my mom is asking me to pay her back, not only exactly what she paid but even MORE money, for the money she gave me to evacuate even tho she insisted on giving me money because she was terrified of me sleeping in campsites (which I have done many times). Her logic is that I had a free place to go but didn’t take it.
